items.title: Coinbase and Gennius Plan ONED Stablecoin Access Through Latin American Banks
items.summary: The Argentina-first initiative would let customers convert eligible deposits into ONED USD, transfer it around the clock and spend through Visa.

items.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
items.summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.

items.title: US plans to seize $1B in crypto linked to Iran this week: Scott Bessent
items.summary: The Treasury Department has announced several digital asset seizures related to sanctions on Iran as part of US sanctions.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Quietly Rehearsing for the Day After an AI Catastrophe
items.summary: Executives are war-gaming the political fallout of a major AI-driven cyberattack and preparing to brief Congress fast if and when necessary.
